description.value: Bless'd Sips & Slices is a family-owned artisan pizza-by-the-slice restaurant located near Gyro Beach in Kelowna, cooking pizzas in a gas-fired brick oven using slow-fermented Italian flour and no canola oil. The restaurant also operates what it bills as the first dirty soda bar in Kelowna, offering hundreds of customizable fizzy drink combinations. Ten percent of profits are donated to local community organizations, and the location is walkable from the popular Okanagan lakeside cycling routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully fetched and active. The address in OSM (3377 Lakeshore Road) conflicts with the address shown consistently across all website pages (3401 Lakeshore Rd), so the website value is used and the discrepancy flagged. Phone (778-484-2573) appears throughout the website but was absent from OSM. Takeout is confirmed by both the OSM takeaway=yes tag and multiple website references to pick-up and online ordering; no bike parking, water refill, washroom, or cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
